# hallpass_integration (Resource)

A Slack or Telegram integration for approving requests from chat. Configure exactly one of `slack` or `telegram`; switching between them forces a new integration. Register `webhook_path` (under the public URL) at the provider. Send requests to chats with `hallpass_notification_route`. Secrets are write-only in HallPass and kept in state. Import with the integration ID (secrets are not imported; set them again).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hallpass_integration" "slack" {
  name = "ops-approvals"
  slack = {
    team_id = "T0123456789"
  }
  secrets = {
    bot_token      = var.slack_bot_token
    signing_secret = var.slack_signing_secret
  }
}

resource "hallpass_integration" "telegram" {
  name = "on-call"
  telegram = {
    bot_username = "acme_hallpass_bot"
  }
  secrets = {
    bot_token = var.telegram_bot_token
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique among integrations.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether messages are sent.
- `secrets` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secret values by name (see `slack` and `telegram`). Changing one sends only that secret.
- `slack` (Attributes) Slack app settings. Secrets: `bot_token`, `signing_secret`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--slack))
- `telegram` (Attributes) Telegram bot settings. Secrets: `bot_token`, and optionally `webhook_secret` (generated when omitted). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--telegram))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Integration ID (`int_…`).
- `webhook_path` (String) Callback path to register at the provider, under the HallPass public URL.

<a id="nestedatt--slack"></a>
### Nested Schema for `slack`

Required:

- `team_id` (String) Workspace ID (`T…`).

Optional:

- `command` (String) Slash command (default `/hallpass`).


<a id="nestedatt--telegram"></a>
### Nested Schema for `telegram`

Optional:

- `allowed_chat_ids` (Set of Number) Group chats besides route destinations that may interact.
- `bot_username` (String) Bot username (without `@`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Integration ID (set secrets again after import)
terraform import hallpass_integration.slack int_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8j
```
